svg.title: Customer Retention AI — end-to-end system flow
svg.desc: Six-layer flow: data sources, feature engineering, AI models, risk classification, action engine, outputs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What CRM data feeds into the Customer Retention AI engine?')
sendPrompt('How are transaction records used in churn prediction?')
sendPrompt('How are support tickets used as a churn signal?')
sendPrompt('What product usage signals predict customer churn?')
sendPrompt('How does the XGBoost model predict churn?')
sendPrompt('How does SHAP feature attribution explain churn predictions?')
sendPrompt('What does LLaMA 3.3 generate for each at-risk customer?')
sendPrompt('How is the priority score and risk tier calculated?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a customer is classified as low churn risk?')
sendPrompt('What automated email is sent to medium risk customers?')
sendPrompt('What deep analysis runs for high risk customers?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a VIP customer is critical churn risk?')
sendPrompt('What does the enterprise retention dashboard display?')
sendPrompt('How does the email campaign engine work?')
sendPrompt('How are human agents alerted about critical customers?')
